bibliographic-data.invention-title: FLIESEN ODER PLATTEN AUS KOMPAKTIERTEM KERAMISCHEM MATERIAL
DALLES OU TUILES DE MATÉRIAU CÉRAMIQUE COMPACT
TILES OR SLABS OF COMPACTED CERAMIC MATERIAL

abstract.p: The invention relates to tiles or slabs comprising a fired ceramic material which has a chemical composition with a particular combination of oxides; to a method for the manufacture of said tiles or slabs; and to the use thereof for construction or decoration applications.
